overview: This is an Order by the Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) in ITC Investigation 337-TA-1270 concerning certain casual footwear and packaging. The ALJ denies respondent Loeffler Randall Inc.'s motion for summary determination of non-infringement based on lack of substantial similarity to the asserted patent claims, finding that genuine issues of material fact remain for trial.

points.point: Respondent Loeffler Randall Inc. moved on September 23, 2021 for summary determination of non-infringement due to lack of substantial similarity.
points.quote: On September 23, 2021, Respondent Loeffler Randall, Inc. ("Loeffler Randall") moved (1270-023) for summary determination of noninfringement due to lack of substantial similarity.

points.point: Complainant Crocs, Inc. and the Commission Investigative Staff opposed Loeffler Randall's motion.
points.quote: Complainant Crocs, Inc. and the Commission Investigative Staff both opposed the motion.

points.point: The question is whether Loeffler Randall's footwear products lack substantial similarity to the asserted patent claims, warranting summary judgment of non-infringement without a trial.
points.quote: summary determination of noninfringement due to lack of substantial similarity. Complainant Crocs, Inc. and the Commission Investigative Staff both opposed the motion.

points.point: The ALJ found that genuine issues of material fact may remain regarding substantial similarity between the products and the asserted patent claims.
points.quote: Because genuine issues of material facts may remain, good cause does not exist to grant the motion in lieu of a trial of all issues on the merits.

points.point: The ALJ denied Loeffler Randall's motion for summary determination of non-infringement.
points.quote: Accordingly, Loeffler Randall's motion (1270-023) is hereby denied.

points.point: All issues in the investigation, including the non-infringement question, remain for trial on the merits.
points.quote: good cause does not exist to grant the motion in lieu of a trial of all issues on the merits.

title: Denying Loeffler Randall Inc.’s Motion for Summary Determination of Non-Infringement Due to Lack of Substantial Similarity
